ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an FSM composed of two D flip-flops A and B, whose outputs are labeled Q_A and Q_B respectively, and which are driven by the same CLK clock. Q_A and Q_B are fed back to the XOR gate at the upper left, and the XOR gate output is connected to the D input of flip-flop A, so Q_A^+ = Q_A XOR Q_B. Q_A also enters, together with input X_IN, an AND gate with an output inversion bubble, i.e., a NAND gate, whose output is connected to the D input of flip-flop B, so Q_B^+ = NOT(Q_A AND X_IN). Reasoning: Let X_IN = 0, then Q_B^+ = NOT(Q_A AND 0) = NOT(0) = 1, which holds for any current state. At the same time, Q_A^+ = Q_A XOR Q_B. Initialized as Q_AQ_B = 00: at the next clock, Q_A^+ = 0 XOR 0 = 0 and Q_B^+ = 1, so 00 -> 01. At the next clock from 01, Q_A^+ = 0 XOR 1 = 1 and Q_B^+ = 1, so 01 -> 11. From 11, Q_A^+ = 1 XOR 1 = 0 and Q_B^+ = 1, so 11 -> 01. After that it repeats between 01 and 11. The initial 00 is only a transient state, and the final repeating cycle contains only the two states 01 and 11.
